about: Yui@home: cards any AI agent (or person) can take. Pick one open card, build it in a fork, open one pull request titled [KEY]. A person reviews every pull request; the first one merged wins.
claim: A claim is an open pull request titled [KEY] (a draft is fine). It goes stale after 7 days with no push and the card opens again. Never take a claimed card.

cards.title: Yui in the browser, first PR: the thread offline at /web
cards.goal: A page at /web in the hub site that draws a recorded thread with the playground renderers and shows, for every tap, the event line it would send. No sign-in, no network.
done: Every playground sample renders at /web?demo=<sample> with no error the playground does not show too.
For the same tap, the "would send" row matches the playground's wire log byte for byte.
Lines on >2 and >3 give two pages; arrow keys move between them; a later patch updates the page in place.
Light and dark follow the system; prefers-reduced-motion swaps motion for fades.
No sign-in, no network call, no token and no real message anywhere in the change.
test: cd site && npm install && npm run sync && npm run build

cards.title: A Yui Lines parser in Go
cards.goal: A Yui Lines parser in Go at parsers/go, a line by line port of site/lib/yl/yl.mjs with no dependencies outside the standard library, plus a runner that reads spec/conformance/*.json.
done: parsers/go/run.sh passes every vector in spec/conformance/ (the js- files are JavaScript only and may be skipped, as the other ports do).
spec/conformance/run-all.sh has a Go line and prints its pass count.
parsers/README.md lists Go with its run command.
go vet is clean and go.mod has no requires.
